title: Polynomial-Time Computation of Extensive-Form Proper Equilibria in Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.07089v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for computing an exact extensive-form proper equilibrium in a finite two-player zero-sum extensive-form game with perfect recall and rational data. Properness is understood in the agent normal form: an action at an information set is penalized relative to a better action while all other local behavioral choices, including the player's own future actions, remain fixed. Our algorithm assigns each information set a geometric permutahedron of allowable action probabilities. A scaled doubly stochastic representation embeds these restrictions in a polynomial-size sequence-form polytope; a saddle point then satisfies the local $\varepsilon$-properness inequalities. translated_title: 二人零和博弈中扩展式恰当均衡的多项式时间计算
translated_abstract: 我们给出一个确定性多项式时间算法，用于在具有完美记忆和有理数数据的有限二人零和扩展式博弈中计算精确的扩展式恰当均衡。恰当性是在智能体正规形式下理解的：在某信息集处，某个行动会相对于更优行动受到惩罚，而所有其他局部行为选择（包括玩家自己未来的行动）保持不变。我们的算法为每个信息集分配一个由允许行动概率构成的几何排列多面体；通过缩放双随机表示，将这些约束嵌入到多项式规模的序列形式多面体中，而鞍点随即满足局部 ε-恰当性不等式。为了得到精确均衡而非在任意小数值扰动下的解，我们建立了参数线性系统的符号稳定性，构造了一个持久的可行基，并提取出行为策略的极限。
tldr: 本文提出了首个确定性多项式时间算法，可在具有完美记忆的有限二人零和扩展式博弈中精确计算（而非近似）扩展式恰当均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for computing exact extensive-form proper equilibria, rather than approximations, in finite two-player zero-sum extensive-form games with perfect recall.
